## Geographic Data Visualization

This interactive map provides a placeholder for geographic data visualization. The map is powered by Leaflet and can be enhanced with custom markers, layers, and data overlays.

### Map Features

- **Pan & Zoom**: Click and drag to pan, use scroll wheel to zoom
- **Interactive**: Hover and click for additional information
- **Multiple Layers**: Support for various map tile providers
- **Custom Markers**: Add location markers with popups and tooltips

```{r}
#| label: leaflet-map
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7

library(leaflet)

# Create an interactive map
leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%  # Add default OpenStreetMap tiles
  setView(lng = -93.65, lat = 42.0285, zoom = 4) %>%

  # Add some sample markers
  addMarkers(
    lng = c(-122.4194, -87.6298, -74.0060),
    lat = c(37.7749, 41.8781, 40.7128),
    popup = c("San Francisco", "Chicago", "New York"),
    label = c("SF", "CHI", "NYC")
  ) %>%

  # Add circle markers for additional locations
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = c(-118.2437, -71.0589, -80.1918),
    lat = c(34.0522, 42.3601, 25.7617),
    radius = 8,
    color = "#667eea",
    fillColor = "#764ba2",
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    popup = c("Los Angeles", "Boston", "Miami"),
    label = c("LA", "BOS", "MIA")
  )
```

## Future Enhancements

This map serves as a placeholder and foundation for more advanced geographic visualizations. Potential enhancements include:

- Real-time data integration
- Custom marker icons and clustering
- Heat maps and choropleth layers
- Geographic search functionality
- Data filtering and layer controls
- Export and sharing capabilities

::: {.callout-tip}
## Integration Ready
This map component can be easily integrated with your data sources. Simply modify the R code above to pull coordinates and information from your database or API.
:::

## Map Controls

The map includes standard Leaflet controls:

- **Zoom Controls**: Located in the top-left corner
- **Attribution**: Map data attribution in the bottom-right
- **Full Screen**: Can be enhanced with additional controls as needed
